tooltips.algorithmMode: Choose the tablebase algorithm. EX uses a more compact in-memory layout and usually reduces memory, disk usage, and computation time; EXAD combines EX storage with the advanced algorithm for very large tables.
tooltips.advanced: The advanced algorithm optimizes processing speed and resource efficiency for massive tables only.
tooltips.zmask: Use the EX algorithm with a compact prefix/suffix bitmap and dense result layout. It usually uses less memory and disk space than the classic layout, and is often faster on large layers.
tooltips.compressTemp: Compress intermediate files to reduce storage usage during computation, at the cost of longer processing time.
tooltips.chunkedSolve: When advanced mode is enabled, chunked solve further reduces memory usage, but it increases disk I/O and is best paired with an SSD.
tooltips.optimalOnly: Post-computation pruning of suboptimal branches. Generally unnecessary.
tooltips.deletionThresholdMode: Turn pruning off, use a fixed success-rate threshold, or prune by a fraction of each layer's best success rate.
tooltips.deletionThreshold: Threshold value used by the selected mode. Larger values create smaller tables but may lose useful states.
tooltips.successRateDtype: Success rate data storage format. Recommended default: uint32.
tooltips.bcFamilyModulus: Fixed family modulus for BC generation and solve. It is selected before the run and is not changed mid-computation.
tooltips.smallTileSumLimit: Controls pruning strength in the advanced algorithm. Higher values keep more low-value tile combinations and increase table size.
